## 🎯 KEY CLARIFICATIONS DOCUMENTED

### **Clarification 1: Daily Study is Daily Incremental**
```
Pattern: Create one day per day (Day 1, Day 2, ..., Day 7)
Coordinated by: TODO.md created on Day 1
Timeline: One week of work = one week of files
```

### **Clarification 2: Mission Tutorials Are Also Daily Incremental**
```
Pattern: Create one step per day (step1, step2, ..., step7)
Coordinated by: TODO.md created on Day 1
Timeline: One week of work = one tutorial (7 steps)
KEY POINT: Tutorials use SAME approach as Daily Study
```

### **Clarification 3: Rust Book Chapters Are All-at-Once**
```
Pattern: Create entire chapter at once (all sections complete)
Coordinated by: Chapter coherence and internal consistency
Timeline: One chapter = one batch of work
KEY POINT: Different approach from Daily Study/Missions
```
